findings.summary: The official embedded menu has 55 current products. The frozen 45 rows include five headings/marketing artifacts and 16 description-only rows that map to named current products.
All four required allergen searches completed without a formal matrix; explicit menu ingredients provide conservative direct positives for a subset of products.
